experiment: Causal rolling calibration of the original MSE20 ensemble toward its own training mean
scope: Exploratory continuation on the repeatedly inspected 141 validation Fridays in 2018-2020. No independent confirmation, complete-paper-replication, profitability or deployment claim. No new market data, features, architecture, loss, epochs or seed selection.
training_contract: Original round6 raw OHLCV combined model, full history and MSE reductions. Each inner model uses only rows with joint_completed <= its inner cutoff, training-only target mean/population SD, unchanged deterministic initialization, full NumPy permutations and AdamW. Nine new fits, 180 actual epochs; reuse the original nine outer MSE20 checkpoints (six also supply inner forecasts). No in-sample neural predictions for calibration.
rolling_forecasts: For each inner cutoff, predict all retained Friday anchors in the next calendar year. The rolling pool has 215 dates: 22,48,50,49,46 in 2015-2019. The first 120 dates require new forecasts; the last 95 reuse frozen original forecasts. Pool membership does not imply label availability: the coefficient-specific maturity mask is mandatory. The invalid 2015-03-27 OHLC row and affected windows/labels remain excluded under the frozen round5 observation contract.

calibration.ensemble: Equal-weight three-seed forecasts; one common fitted alpha per outer cutoff, applied to every outer seed and hence to its ensemble.
calibration.selection: Keep Friday signals from January 1 of cutoff_year-2 through outer cutoff, and require joint_completed <= outer cutoff. Require the forecasting model inner_cutoff < signal_date. Targets are raw executable returns; each row's center is its own inner model training mean.
calibration.formula: x=p_inner_ensemble-m_inner; z=y-m_inner; alpha=clip(sum(x*z)/sum(x*x),0,1). Equal weight per week, no fitted intercept, volatility weighting, coefficient grid or outer-label tuning. If count/year/denominator requirements fail, alpha=0. At prediction time use m_outer + alpha*(p_outer-m_outer).
calibration.timing: Freeze all three coefficient artifacts before any round13 outer evaluation. 2018/2019 outcomes may calibrate later models only after labels mature; they never calibrate their own or earlier forecasting model.

fixed_reference: The 0.5 coefficient is a prespecified diagnostic reference for generic shrinkage, motivated by round12 amplitude accounting. It is not selected on this round's results or claimed to be data-independent.
training_only_diagnostics: Report raw/clipped alpha, sufficient-statistic numerator/denominator, yearly contributions and leave-one-calibration-year-out coefficients with the same closed form (minimum 52 weeks and two remaining years). These alternative coefficients are diagnostic only and never enter outer forecasts or candidate selection. Do not estimate an outer-period optimal alpha.
outer_validation: Reuse exactly the original 423 seed predictions over 49+46+46 weeks; apply the frozen transforms. Include training-mean and zero-return references. Report ensemble/year/seed MSE, RMSE, MAE, direction accuracy, balanced accuracy, correlation and forecast SD, plus changed direction counts. No trading PnL, costs, leverage or threshold optimization.
inference: Four prespecified paired weekly ensemble MSE comparisons. Circular 8-observation blocks, 10000 replicates, seed 20260910, centered two-sided p, Holm over all four. Percentile 95% intervals are descriptive and need not invert the centered test. Refit uncertainty, repeated historical experimentation and calibration/evaluation overlap across later folds are not fully accounted for; no confirmatory p-value interpretation.
descriptive_screen: Predeclared candidate rolling_shrink. Six flags: ensemble MSE beats archived20 and training_mean; at least 2/3 matched seeds beat archived20; at least 2/3 seeds beat training_mean; at least 2/3 years beat archived20; at least 2/3 years beat training_mean. All six required for the local descriptive screen. Fixed-half results cannot silently replace the declared candidate. No automatic strategy promotion.
verification: Freeze core scripts, input/cache hashes and all 2341 previous evidence files before fitting. Contract-test causal masks/scales, clipped least-squares endpoints/degeneracy, transform/ensemble commutation and real-model update parity. Replay all 18 distinct neural states needed by inner/outer forecasts, nine final training-loss passes, 180 permutation/batch logs and optimizer counters, 645 rolling seed forecasts and 423 outer base forecasts. Independently rederive every coefficient membership/formula, leave-year diagnostic, outer transform, metric, primary test and descriptive flag. Preserve all prior files.
